c.v: The clock sources for RTC_SLOW_CLK and RTC_FAST_CLK are low-frequency clocks.
RTC module can operate when most other clocks are stopped.
RTC_SLOW_CLK is derived from RC_SLOW_CLK, XTAL32K_CLK or RC_FAST_DIV_CLK and used to clock Power Management module.
RTC_FAST_CLK is used to clock On-chip Sensor module.
